# One VBA expression per line.  Each is evaluated in real Excel by
# scripts/measure_vba_semantics.py and the answer is recorded in
# measured.json, which tests/test_vba_semantics.py holds the interpreter
# to.  Lines starting with # are comments.
#
# The point of the list is the places an interpreter guesses wrong:
# integer width and overflow, how a number becomes a string, what Null
# and Empty do to each operator, and which error number comes out.

# --- literals and the widths they carry ---
TypeName(1)
TypeName(40000)
TypeName(1&)
TypeName(1%)
TypeName(1!)
TypeName(1#)
TypeName(1@)
TypeName(1.5)
TypeName("a")
TypeName(True)
TypeName(Empty)
TypeName(Null)
TypeName(#1/1/2020#)
TypeName(CDec(1))
TypeName(CByte(1))
TypeName(Array(1, 2))
&H10
&H8000
&HFFFF
&HFFFFFFFF
&O17
1000000000 + 1000000000

# --- arithmetic and its overflow ---
30000 + 30000
30000& + 30000
7 / 2
7 \ 2
-7 \ 2
7.6 \ 2
7 Mod 3
-7 Mod 3
7.6 Mod 3
2 ^ 10
2 ^ 0.5
-2 ^ 2
CInt(1.5)
CInt(2.5)
CInt(-2.5)
CInt(0.5)
CLng(2.5)
Int(-1.5)
Fix(-1.5)
Int(1.5)
Round(0.5)
Round(1.5)
Round(2.5)
Round(2.675, 2)
Round(-0.5)
Abs(-3)
Sgn(-3)
1 / 0
CInt(40000)
CByte(-1)
0.1 + 0.2
1 / 3
CStr(1 / 3)
CStr(0.1 + 0.2)
CStr(1000000000000000)
CStr(10000000000000000)
CStr(0.0001)
CStr(0.00001)
CStr(0.000001)
CStr(123456789.123456)
CStr(1.5E+300)
CStr(-0.5)
CStr(CSng(1 / 3))
CSng(1 / 3)
CCur(1 / 3)
CDec(1) / 3

# --- strings ---
"10" + 5
"10" & 5
"a" + 5
1 & 2
Left("abc", 5)
Left("abc", 0)
Right("abc", 5)
Mid("abcdef", 3)
Mid("abcdef", 3, 2)
Mid("abc", 5)
Len("abc")
Len(Empty)
# Len of a numeric literal does not compile in VBA at all, so the byte
# widths are measured through variables, which is the only way to see
# that Len is a size in bytes for anything that is not a string.
Dim n As Long: n = 12345 ;; Len(n)
Dim i As Integer: i = 1 ;; Len(i)
Dim d As Double: d = 1 ;; Len(d)
Dim b As Byte: b = 1 ;; Len(b)
Dim c As Currency: c = 1 ;; Len(c)
Dim t As Date: t = Now ;; Len(t)
Dim q As Variant: q = 12345 ;; Len(q)
Dim y As Boolean ;; Len(y)
InStr("abcabc", "b")
InStr(3, "abcabc", "b")
InStr("abcabc", "z")
InStr("abc", "")
InStrRev("abcabc", "b")
Replace("aaa", "a", "b")
Replace("aaa", "a", "b", 2)
Replace("aaa", "a", "b", 1, 2)
Replace("AAA", "a", "b", 1, -1, 1)
UCase("aBc")
Trim("  a  ")
String(3, "x")
String(3, 65)
Space(3) & "|"
StrReverse("abc")
StrComp("a", "B")
StrComp("a", "B", 1)
Asc("A")
Chr(65)
Chr(200)
AscW("A")
UBound(Split("a,b,c", ","))
UBound(Split("", ","))
Join(Array("a", "b"), "-")
"abc" Like "a*"
"abc" Like "a?c"
"a1c" Like "a#c"
"abc" Like "[a-c]bc"
"ABC" Like "abc"

# --- Null, Empty and the comparisons ---
Empty + 1
Empty & "a"
Empty = 0
Empty = ""
Empty > 0
IsEmpty(Empty)
Null + 1
Null & "a"
Null & Null
IsNull(Null + 1)
IsNull(Null = Null)
Null = Null
IsNull(Null And True)
Null And False
Null Or True
True And Null
1 < "1"
"a" < "B"
"A" < "a"
True + True
-True
True * 5
Not 5
5 And 3
5 Or 3
5 Xor 3
True Imp False
CBool(2)
CBool("True")
IsNumeric("1.5")
IsNumeric("1,5")
IsNumeric(" 12 ")
IsNumeric("&H10")
IsDate("2/29/2024")
IsDate("2/30/2024")
Val("12abc")
Val("1.5e2x")
Val(" 1 2 ")
Val("&H10")
Str(12)
Str(-12)
Hex(255)
Hex(-1)
Oct(8)

# --- dates ---
CDbl(#1/1/2020#)
CStr(#1/1/2020#)
CStr(#1/1/2020 3:04:05 PM#)
CStr(#3:04:05 PM#)
CDbl(#12/30/1899#)
CDbl(#12/29/1899#)
Year(#2/29/2024#)
Month(#2/29/2024#)
Day(#2/29/2024#)
Weekday(#1/1/2020#)
Weekday(#1/1/2020#, 2)
WeekdayName(1)
MonthName(2, True)
DateSerial(2020, 13, 1)
DateSerial(2020, 1, 32)
DateSerial(2020, 3, 0)
DateAdd("m", 1, #1/31/2020#)
DateAdd("d", -1, #1/1/2020#)
DateAdd("yyyy", 1, #2/29/2020#)
DateDiff("d", #1/1/2020#, #3/1/2020#)
DateDiff("m", #1/31/2020#, #2/1/2020#)
DateDiff("yyyy", #12/31/2019#, #1/1/2020#)
DatePart("q", #5/1/2020#)
DateValue(#1/1/2020 3:00:00 PM#)
CDate("1/1/2020")
CDate(43831)
CDate("not a date")
TimeSerial(25, 0, 0)

# --- Format ---
Format(1234.5, "#,##0.00")
Format(0.5, "0%")
Format(#1/2/2020#, "yyyy-mm-dd")
Format(#1/2/2020#, "dddd")
Format(5, "00000")
Format(-5, "#,##0;(#,##0)")
Format(0.125, "0.00")
Format(0.135, "0.00")
Format("abc", ">")
FormatNumber(1234.5)
FormatPercent(0.5, 0)
FormatCurrency(1234.5)
FormatDateTime(#1/2/2020#, 2)

# --- where a Double stops printing in full and starts using an exponent ---
CStr(100000000000000#)
CStr(999999999999999#)
CStr(1000000000000000#)
CStr(1234567890123456#)
CStr(-1000000000000000#)
CStr(1.5E+15)
CStr(1E+20)
CStr(0.0001)
CStr(0.000012345)
CStr(0.0000001)
CStr(0.00000001)
CStr(0.0000000001)
CStr(1E-20)
CStr(1.5E-7)
CStr(CSng(0.0000001))
CStr(CSng(100000000))
CStr(CSng(1E+15))
CStr(1E-11)
CStr(1E-12)
CStr(1E-13)
CStr(1E-14)
CStr(1E-15)
CStr(1E-16)
CStr(1E-17)
CStr(1.23456789012345E-11)
CStr(1.23456789012345E-15)
CStr(CSng(1E-8))
CStr(CSng(1E-10))
CStr(CSng(1E-38))
CStr(CSng(12345678))
CStr(CSng(1234567))
CStr(1E+15 - 1)
CStr(9999999999999998#)
# The constant modules of VBA's type library: colours, key codes, system colours, forms.
vbRed
TypeName(vbRed)
vbKeyReturn
TypeName(vbKeyA)
vbButtonFace
vbModeless
vbFormCode
TypeName(vbOK)
TypeName(vbTextCompare)
TypeName(vbObjectError)
TypeName(vbKeyF1)
TypeName(vbBlack)
vbYes * 10000
vbKeyA * 1000
# An exact tie at the last digit shown goes away from zero, a Single's as a Double's.
CStr(CSng(2 ^ -11))
CStr(-CSng(2 ^ -11))
CStr(CSng(16777205))
CStr(CSng(16777215))
CStr(3109126351029605#)
CStr(-3109126351029605#)

# --- errors the interpreter has to raise with the same number ---
Left("a", -1)
Mid("a", 0)
Space(-1)
Chr(-99999)
Sqr(-1)
Log(0)
Array(1, 2)(5)
CDate("x")
"a" * 2
Asc("")
StrReverse(Null)

# --- an Error Variant through the conversion functions: its number, except where arithmetic reads it ---
CLng(CVErr(2042))
CInt(CVErr(2042))
CDbl(CVErr(2042))
CSng(CVErr(2042))
CCur(CVErr(2042))
CByte(CVErr(5))
CStr(CVErr(2042))
Val(CVErr(2042))
Int(CVErr(2042))
CVErr(2042) + 1

# --- Scripting.Dictionary, made with CreateObject ---
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") ;; TypeName(d)
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") ;; d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") ;; d.CompareMode
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1 ;; d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1 ;; d("a")
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1 ;; d.Item("a")
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1 ;; d.Exists("a")
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1 ;; d.Exists("A")
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.CompareMode = vbTextCompare: d.Add "a", 1 ;; d.Exists("A")
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.CompareMode = vbTextCompare: d.Add "a", 1: d.Add "A", 2 ;; d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1: d.Add "a", 2 ;; d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") ;; IsEmpty(d("missing"))
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): v = d("missing") ;; d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): v = d.Exists("missing") ;; d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d("k") = 5 ;; d("k")
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d("k") = 5: d("k") = 6 ;; d("k") & "," & d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1: d.Item("a") = 9 ;; d("a")
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "b", 1: d.Add "a", 2 ;; Join(d.Keys, ",")
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "b", 1: d.Add "a", 2 ;; Join(d.Items, ",")
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1: d.Add "b", 2 ;; LBound(d.Keys) & "," & UBound(d.Keys)
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") ;; UBound(d.Keys)
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") ;; TypeName(d.Keys)
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1: d.Add "b", 2 ;; d.Items()(1)
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1: d.Add "b", 2: d.Remove "a" ;; Join(d.Keys, ",")
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Remove "zz" ;; d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1: d.RemoveAll ;; d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1: d.Remove "a": d.Add "a", 2 ;; Join(d.Keys, ",") & d("a")
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1: d.Key("a") = "b" ;; Join(d.Keys, ",") & d("b")
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1: d.Key("zz") = "b" ;; d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1: d.Add "b", 2: d.Key("a") = "b" ;; d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1: d.CompareMode = vbTextCompare ;; d.CompareMode
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add 1, "one" ;; d.Exists("1")
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add 1, "one" ;; d.Exists(1#)
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add 1, "one" ;; d(1&)
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add CInt(1), "i": d.Add CDbl(1), "d" ;; d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "1", "s": d.Add 1, "n" ;; d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add 1.5, "x" ;; d(1.5)
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add #1/1/2020#, 1 ;; d.Exists(43831)
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add True, 1 ;; d.Exists(-1)
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add Empty, 1 ;; d.Exists("") & "," & d.Exists(Empty)
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add Null, 1 ;; d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): Dim o As Object: Set o = New Collection: d.Add o, 1 ;; d.Exists(o)
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", Array(1, 2) ;; d("a")(1)
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): Dim k As Variant, s As String: d.Add "a", 1: d.Add "b", 2: For Each k In d: s = s & k: Next ;; s
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"): d.Add "a", 1 ;; d.Count + d.Count
Dim d As Object: Set d = CreateObject("scripting.dictionary") ;; TypeName(d)
